description:
Browse with clear, familiar mobile controls—and spend less time waiting on artificial page delays.

Speed Browser can accelerate JavaScript timeouts and intervals from 1× to 100×. Choose quick presets, enter an exact multiplier, or disable acceleration for websites that need normal timing. Each timer API can be controlled independently.

Manual mode gives you a live view of active page timers. Invoke a timer immediately, pause invocations, disable one call, block a repeating source, or hide noisy sources.

Speed Browser keeps your preferences and recent URLs on your device. It contains no ads and no third-party analytics.

Speed Browser changes JavaScript timer behavior. It does not speed up downloads, media playback, network requests, or CSS animations. Some websites may behave unexpectedly at high multipliers; you can always switch to 1× or disable acceleration for that site.
promotionalText: A familiar iOS browser with precise controls for skipping artificial JavaScript timer delays.
whatsNew: Introducing Speed Browser: focused mobile browsing, configurable JavaScript timer acceleration, per-site controls, and a manual timer inspector.
